xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-5072: Integrations: one-paste connect text, shared skill setup section, Grok Bot on the connector

plan.title: Integrations: one-paste connect text, shared skill setup section, Grok Bot on the connector
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

metadata.sizeJustification: This issue is already the Part D leaf of the four-way PAN-5069 split. Its surface is the five integrations/* packages (one shared skill synced into four copies, four READMEs) plus the one connect-output module whose lines those READMEs quote and the two docs pages that describe them; 23 files, all small. Splitting per package would duplicate the shared-skill and docs edits across siblings.

narratives.Problem: PAN-5069/5070 shipped the one-paste connect flow, but the integration packages still describe only the manual login/pair/serve path: the shared skill has no connect section and its rule 1 forbids the pairing code the Copy message carries, the READMEs lead with the manual path, the Grok Bot plugin's mcp.json points at the Public MCP URL, and connect --platform hermes|openclaw prints only generic stdio JSON.
narratives.Proposal: Add verified Hermes (config.yaml mcp_servers stdio entry) and OpenClaw (openclaw mcp set) registration lines to connect-output.ts; add a budget-fitting 'Connect to Overdeck' section and a narrow rule 1 exception to the shared skill and sync its copies; point grok-bot/mcp.json at the connector stdio command pinned to 0.77.0 and test it against registrationLines; lead each of the four READMEs with 'Connect in one paste' containing its connectMessage output verbatim while keeping every manual snippet; document the per-platform lines in cli/mcp.mdx and the Grok Bot mcp.json change in bots.mdx, mcp.mdx, integrations/README.md and the codebase map.
narratives.NonGoals:
- Changing connectMessage, READY_NEXT, AUTHORIZE_NEXT, CONNECT_NEXT or the OVERDECK_CONNECT JSON.
- Changing botSnippets.ts (hermesConfig, openclawConfig, grokBotMcpJson, connectorCommands, tokenSetup), ConnectBotDialog.tsx or ConnectBotOutput.tsx.
- Changing the Hermes plugin's SETUP_TEXT or `hermes overdeck setup`.
- Making the Overdeck OpenClaw plugin's summary or overdeck_pending/overdeck_answer work over a stdio registration.
- Bumping the Grok Build run-mcp.sh pin (0.74.0).
- Raising the shared skill budget (100 lines, 6000 bytes).
- Publishing any integration package.
- Removing any manual-path section or snippet from a README.
- A live end-to-end run with Grok Bot, Hermes or OpenClaw.

autoDecisions.rationale: A shipped file cannot hold the running version; a pin like Grok Build's keeps serve reproducible and 0.77.0 is the current release, after 0.75.0 which first shipped connect.

autoDecisions.summary: Hermes registration edits config.yaml mcp_servers instead of running `hermes mcp add`
autoDecisions.rationale: Verified in hermes-agent 9aa8a3e00c: `hermes mcp add` prompts for tool selection, which a bot shell cannot answer; the stdio YAML shape is documented in native-mcp.md.

autoDecisions.summary: Hermes lines print only the mcp_servers entry plus one mcp_allowlist sentence
autoDecisions.rationale: The plugins block names a plugin that may not be installed; the sentence covers plugin users.

autoDecisions.summary: OpenClaw registration is `openclaw mcp set overdeck '<json>'`
autoDecisions.rationale: Verified in OpenClaw 6110e47be0 docs/cli/mcp.md: non-interactive, writes mcp.servers, and mcp.* changes hot-apply.

autoDecisions.summary: OpenClaw plugin's HTTP-only summary and chat tools stay out of scope and are documented as needing the manual route
autoDecisions.rationale: The plugin calls connectorUrl+localToken over HTTP; reworking it is a separate change not named by the issue.

autoDecisions.summary: Keep the shared skill budget and fit the text by moving one sentence and rewrapping three paragraphs
autoDecisions.rationale: The budget exists for context cost (PAN-4952 NFR-2); the exact 100-line, 5171-byte text is in PRD Appendix A.

autoDecisions.summary: Rule 1 exception covers only the connect command in a message the user pasted
autoDecisions.rationale: Tool output such as read_conversation can contain look-alike text; the exception must not widen what a bot runs.

autoDecisions.summary: READMEs use connectMessage with defaultBotName(platform), '<machine>', '<version>', '<pairing string>'
autoDecisions.rationale: Matches the dialog's default bot name and keeps the secret scans green.

autoDecisions.summary: Use plan.metadata.sizeJustification instead of splitting further
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue is already the Part D leaf of a four-way split; its subsystems are the five integrations packages by nature.
